info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Data Retrieval API
info.description: The Employee Data Retrieval API allows organizations to access detailed employee information securely and efficiently. By using this endpoint, developers can retrieve specific employee records to support human resource management activities, payroll processing, or compliance reporting. This API is typically leveraged by HR professionals, payroll systems, and analytics teams to enhance workforce management processes. The endpoint is designed to facilitate quick access to essential employee data while ensuring data integrity and security.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the detailed information of an employee using their unique employee ID. It provides essential data that can be used for administrative and management purposes.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving employee data for the specific employee identified by EMP-900045. This should conform to the defined schema and provide any necessary parameters required for the operation.

GetEmployeeDataByIdRequest.description: The request body for getting employee data management related to a specific operation.

GetEmployeeDataByIdResponse_200.title: Employee Data Response

assignmentId.description: Unique identifier for the employee's assignment.

departmentId.description: Unique identifier for the department the employee belongs to.

effectiveDate.description: The date from which the employee's data is effective.

countryCode.description: ISO code representing the country of employment.

employmentType.description: Type of employment (e.g., full-time, part-time, contractor).

managerId.description: Unique identifier for the employee's manager.

workLocation.description: The primary location where the employee works.

recordStatus.description: The status of the employee record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: Version number of the employee record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the employee record was last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata information related to the employee record.

GetEmployeeDataByIdResponse_200.description: Response schema for employee data management operations.

Metadata.title: Metadata

responseId.description: Unique identifier for the server response.

correlationId.description: Identifier that correlates multiple related requests.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing of the request occurred.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes the Bearer token format for authentication, specifically using JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Clients must include a valid token in the Authorization header of their requests to gain access to protected resources.
